ios.desc: Unleash your creativity with Photocraft, where every image and sketch is a canvas waiting to be reimagined. Whether you're dreaming of turning a simple photo into a stunning piece of photography, a moody black-and-white masterpiece, or an impressionist painting filled with color and emotion, Photocraft is your gateway to artistic exploration. Imagine your sketches coming to life as vibrant anime scenes, intricate 3D illustrations, or edgy cyberpunk visions. All of this is right at your fingertips, with no cloud, no subscriptions, and no limits. Just pure, unfiltered creativity. Dive into the world of Photocraft, where your imagination takes the lead, and your creations are truly your own.

quotes.text: Hi. What makes PhotoCraft different from the dozens of other AI photo editing apps on the App Store? There is also already another AI photo app of the same name: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/photocraft-art-from-any-image/id6476209041.
quotes.story_title: Show HN: PhotoCraft – an AI photo editor I built and shipped as my first iOS app
